Converts a number or a text to a UShort, a 16-bit integer from 0 to 65535. This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the originals only know `Int` and `Float`. A whole number that is too large or below 0 keeps its lowest 16 bits (`UShort(-1)` is 65535), a real is rounded to the nearest whole number (halves go to the even one) and stops at 0 or 65535 if it is outside. Use [SatUShort](SatUShort) to stop whole numbers at the limits as well.

```blitzbasic
;run
Print UShort(-1)
Print UShort(65536)
Print UShort(70000.0)
```

```text
65535
0
65535
```
@param value  A number or a text with a number in it. A text may start with `$`, `0x`, `%` or `0b` for hexadecimal or binary digits.
@returns The UShort.
@gap Not in the originals, which have no integers of other sizes.
